name: rosetta-linear-congruential-generator
code:
use default

bsd_rand(seed: int) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[int] is
    let state mut = cast long(seed)

    do
        state = (1103515245L * state + 12345L) % 2147483648L
        yield cast(state)
    od
si

ms_rand(seed: int) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[int] is
    let state mut = cast long(seed)

    do
        state = (214013L * state + 2531011L) % 2147483648L
        yield cast(state / 65536L)
    od
si

let bsd_text = bsd_rand(0) |> take(10) |> map(n => "{n}") |> join(", ")
let ms_text = ms_rand(0) |> take(10) |> map(n => "{n}") |> join(", ")

write_line("BSD rand, seed 0: {bsd_text}")
write_line("MS rand, seed 0: {ms_text}")
